messages:
ops-bot: INCIDENT 2812345678 — Latency spike detected on continuous-batching execution path (us-west-2). p95 elevated, p99 breach. Paging on-call.

ops-bot: metrics snapshot: p95=320ms, p99=2.4s, error-rate ~0.4% for streaming endpoints. Routing backlog increasing.

sara: I'm on call — ack. pulling dashboard now.

mike: taking console. I see a sudden jump at 12:04 UTC. streaming stalls look correlated with long batch durations.

sara: confirm. bucketed by seq_len, long requests (>=1024 tokens) are forming very large batches (~64) and blocking streaming slots.

leo: any KV cache churn signs? when batch timeouts spike, KV cache gets evicted more often.

mike: yes. KV cache hitrate dropped from 92% to 68% during the window. looks like prefix reuse dropped.

anjali: dropping KV hitrate explains repeated recompute and heavy kernel loads. that can amplify tail.

sara: quick mitigation proposal: reduce max_batch_size from 64 -> 32 for the continuous-batching pool and lower batch_timeout from 40ms -> 20ms.

mike: +1. also suggest enabling per-request streaming priority for low-latency routes so they preempt big batches.

product-liaison: heads up — product is seeing customer reports for live chat delays. please keep us posted.

support-jamie: we have 3 tickets flagged as P1 (IDs: #12894, #12899, #12902) — customers report long pauses in streaming and partial responses.

sara: executing mitigation: updating pool config now. running helm patch to set maxBatch=32 and batchMs=20 on cbatch-pool-2.

mike: pasting prometheus query I'm watching:
```
max_over_time(request_duration_seconds{job=\"cbatch-runtime\",region=\"us-west-2\"}[5m])
```
values before patch: 2.4s; watch for drop.

ops-bot: DEPLOYMENT: config patch started by sara at 12:11 UTC. CI checks passed.

leo: logs from scheduler during spike (snip):
```
2026-03-14T12:04:23Z scheduler: batch_id=abcd timeout=40ms queued=120
2026-03-14T12:04:23Z runtime: exec_duration=2300ms slot_wait=1800ms
2026-03-14T12:04:24Z kvcache: evict key=ctx:xyz size=1.2MB reason=mem_pressure
```

anjali: that slot_wait 1800ms is the story. when big batches accumulate, streaming tasks wait and then stall.

mike: config patch finished. rolling update of cbatch-pool-2.

ops-bot: ROLLOUT complete at 12:15 UTC.

sara: metrics: p95 dropped to 140ms, p99 to 480ms within 60s of the change. KV hitrate climbing back to 88%.

support-jamie: updated tickets with mitigation notes and ETA for full recovery. customers acknowledged.

product-liaison: thanks — one customer (org: qlives) asked for postmortem. file created: INC-2812345678-qlives.

leo: quick follow-ups: 1) add a short-term scheduler rule to prefer streaming-tagged requests; 2) add per-tenant max_batch caps to avoid a few heavy callers from amplifying padding; 3) investigate holding KV entries longer during spikes.

anjali: agree. also evaluate adaptive batching that considers seq_len distribution instead of raw count. padding amplification is killing throughput.

mike: opened infra ticket INFRA-4620 for per-tenant caps. tagging eng-runtime and eng-platform.

sara: creating incident doc and timeline now. will add graphs + config diff.

ops-bot: NOTE: incident severity lowered to S2 at 12:25 UTC (customer impact reduced).

leo: handing off monitoring and long-term action items to mike — I'm stepping out for the next rotation.

mike: taking over. I'll own the incident doc and coordinate with eng-runtime on the adaptive batching spikes.

sara: thanks leo. mike — next steps for you: 1) coordinate with eng-runtime on scheduler fast-path, 2) ensure per-tenant cap rollout plan, 3) write postmortem with remediation timeline.

mike: on it. will post an update in #incidents when draft is ready.

support-jamie: closing customer-facing loop: messages queued to affected customers; helpdesk will follow up individually.

product-liaison: will track postmortem and decide whether to notify broader customers.

mike: final note — we avoided rollback; config tweak worked. leaving monitoring alerts on for 6h. if p99 > 1s re-escalate. :eyes:

sara: thanks team. handing to mike for 0500 UTC check. I'm off call. :party-parrot:

mike: acknowledged. I'll cover the handoff and follow-ups.
